title: Qwen Image 2.1 45° angle shots
description: A genuine camera-angle reshot of one reference image using the Qwen Image 2.1 Multiple-Angles v2 LoRA. The model receives an explicit <mva> azimuth/elevation instruction and the source image; it does not promise a 3D orbit. Every angle is a separate run with its own Slate.

controls.label: Angle instruction
controls.default: Keep the subject, wardrobe, composition and background exactly as in the reference image.

values.prompt: <mva> front-left quarter view, eye-level shot. Keep the subject identity, wardrobe, scene and visual style.
<mva> left side view, eye-level shot. Keep the subject identity, wardrobe, scene and visual style.

requirements.name: qwen21_multiple_angles_v2.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Install the step-1,500 rank-64 v2 LoRA under models/loras and verify its SHA-256. The LoRA is Apache-2.0; the Qwen Image 2.1 base remains under the Qwen Research License.

evidence: This graph is the existing Qwen Image 2.1 edit template with one source image, a LoraLoaderModelOnly step at strength 1.0, and explicit <mva> preset prompts. The LoRA is Qwen-Image-2.1 Multiple-Angles v2 step 1500, Apache-2.0, 319 MB, trained for the installed Qwen Image 2.1 base.

The source image is the only image input; no reference or mask is supplied. This is a generative angle reshot, not a reconstructed 3D orbit. Real output and identity fidelity must be reviewed per image.
